header.one_liner: GSL is a Goan defence shipyard specialising in Offshore Patrol Vessels (OPVs), Fast Patrol Vessels (FPVs), Mine Counter-Measure Vessels (MCMVs), and auxiliary ships for the Indian Navy and Indian Coas

at_a_glance.Headquarters: Vasco da Gama, Goa, India (West Coast)
at_a_glance.Founded: 1957 (as Estaleiros Navais de Goa by Portuguese colonial administration; nationalised post-1961 liberation)
at_a_glance.Listed: Not listed — Schedule 'B' Miniratna Category-I CPSE under Ministry of Defence
at_a_glance.Key India role: GSL is a Goan defence shipyard specialising in Offshore Patrol Vessels (OPVs), Fast Patrol Vessels (FPVs), Mine Counter-Measure Vessels (MCMVs), and auxiliary ships for the Indian Navy and Indian Coas

what_it_is.prose: GSL is a Goan defence shipyard specialising in Offshore Patrol Vessels (OPVs), Fast Patrol Vessels (FPVs), Mine Counter-Measure Vessels (MCMVs), and auxiliary ships for the Indian Navy and Indian Coast Guard. The yard has built 200+ ships in 56+ years. Major programmes: 5 Sankalp-class Advanced Offshore Patrol Vessels (AOPVs, last delivered Oct 2021); 8 Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessels for the Indian Coast Guard (lead ship 'Adamya' inducted; 7th FPV delivered Aug 25, 2026); 11 Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessels (NGOPVs) split with GRSE — lead ship 'Shachi' launched at GSL Mar 31, 2026; MCMV project (12 vessels, ~₹32,000 Cr) awarded by MoD.

rows.platform_or_product: Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessels (NGOPVs) — Shachi class
rows.india_status: 11 NGOPVs split between GSL and GRSE. Lead ship 'Shachi' launched at GSL Mar 31, 2026. Designed for coastal defence, surveillance, SAR, protection of offshore assets, mine warfare
8 FPVs being built for Indian Coast Guard. Lead ship 'Adamya' inducted; 7th FPV delivered Aug 25, 2026. 60% indigenous content, 35 knots, 50 m waterjet-propulsion
5 AOPVs delivered to Indian Coast Guard (final 4th Sankalp-class delivered Oct 2021); 24 knots top speed, 6,500 nm range, armed with 2x 30 mm CRN-91 naval guns
12 MCMVs ordered by MoD (~₹32,000 Cr). GSL to build vessels capable of locating, classifying, sweeping and neutralising all types of ground/moored/drift mines
